ownerEntity.rule: Uppercase and trim the owner name(s), then flag as entity if it matches the regex (apply to every owner field; any hit = entity). Note: TRUSTEE does not match the TRUST word rule, and a surname such as CHURCH at the start of the name is a known false positive.
ownerEntity.sqlApproxWhere: (UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% LLC%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% INC%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% LP%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% LLP%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% LTD%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% TRUST%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% CHURCH%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% COMPANY%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% PARTNERSHIP%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% HOLDINGS%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% PROPERTIES%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '% CORP%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '%,LLC%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE '%,INC%' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE 'CITY OF %' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE 'COUNTY OF %' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE 'STATE OF %' OR UPPER(OWNER) LIKE 'TOWN OF %')
ownerEntity.countNote: The live count uses the SQL approximation (LIKE '% TOKEN%' on the primary owner field, which also catches TRUSTEE/INCOME-style prefixes) together with the acreage filter above.
